model.finova_dbt_lab.dim_customer_dv.raw_code:
-- Grain: 1 dòng = 1 phiên bản khách theo thời điểm hệ thống biết, cộng 1 dòng "không xác định"
-- Dựng từ satellite, không từ staging: lịch sử đã nằm ở vault
with v as (
    select
        s.customer_hk, h.customer_id, s.segment, s.kyc_status, s.ingested_ts,
        lead(s.ingested_ts) over (partition by s.customer_hk order by s.ingested_ts) as next_ts,
        row_number()        over (partition by s.customer_hk order by s.ingested_ts) as version_no
    from {{ ref('sat_customer__luyen_tap') }} s
    join {{ ref('hub_customer') }} h on h.customer_hk = s.customer_hk
)
select
    {{ hash_key([fmt_hk('customer_hk'), fmt_ts('ingested_ts')]) }}     as customer_key,
    customer_hk,
    customer_id::text                                                  as customer_id,
    segment::text                                                      as segment,
    kyc_status::text                                                   as kyc_status,
    ingested_ts                                                        as valid_from_ts,
    coalesce(next_ts, 'infinity'::timestamptz)                         as valid_to_ts,
    next_ts is null                                                    as is_current,
    version_no::int                                                    as version_no
from v
union all
select {{ unknown_key() }}, null, '<UNKNOWN>', 'UNKNOWN', 'UNKNOWN', '-infinity', 'infinity', false, 0

model.finova_dbt_lab.mart_account_daily.name: mart_account_daily
model.finova_dbt_lab.mart_account_daily.description: Grain: 1 dòng = 1 tài khoản × 1 ngày giao dịch, bảng dày. cash_balance là tiền đã thanh toán tới hết ngày; nav = cash_balance + market_value.
model.finova_dbt_lab.mart_account_daily.raw_code:
-- Grain: 1 dòng = 1 tài khoản × 1 ngày giao dịch (bảng dày: đủ mọi tài khoản, mọi phiên, kể cả ngày không phát sinh)
-- Phạm vi ngày: các ngày có dữ liệu số dư chứng khoán (ngày chụp đầu kỳ tới phiên cuối)
-- cash_balance: tiền đã thanh toán tới hết ngày (giao dịch theo ngày giờ Việt Nam)
with bounds as (
    select min(snapshot_date) as d0, max(snapshot_date) as d1
    from {{ ref('fact_position_daily') }}
),
cal as (
    select d.date_key, d.date_day, d.is_trading_day, d.trading_day_number
    from {{ ref('dim_date') }} d, bounds
    where d.date_day between bounds.d0 and bounds.d1
),
acc as (
    select account_key, account_id from {{ ref('dim_account') }} where account_id <> '<UNKNOWN>'
),
cash_day as (
    select account_key, date_key, sum(signed_amount) as cash_flow
    from {{ ref('fact_cash_txn') }}
    group by 1, 2
),
grid as (
    -- lưới đủ mọi ngày lịch để cộng dồn không sót giao dịch rơi vào ngày nghỉ
    select acc.account_key, acc.account_id, cal.date_key, cal.date_day, cal.is_trading_day, cal.trading_day_number,
           coalesce(cd.cash_flow, 0) as cash_flow
    from acc
    cross join cal
    left join cash_day cd on cd.account_key = acc.account_key and cd.date_key = cal.date_key
),
-- dòng tiền phát sinh trước ngày đầu tiên của lưới (nếu có) được cộng vào số dư mở đầu
cash_before as (
    select f.account_key, sum(f.signed_amount) as opening_cash
    from {{ ref('fact_cash_txn') }} f, bounds
    where f.date_key < {{ date_key('bounds.d0') }}
    group by 1
),
cash_cum as (
    select g.*,
           coalesce(cb.opening_cash, 0)
             + sum(g.cash_flow) over (partition by g.account_key order by g.date_day) as cash_balance
    from grid g
    left join cash_before cb on cb.account_key = g.account_key
),
mv as (
    select account_key, date_key, sum(market_value) as market_value
    from {{ ref('fact_position_daily') }}
    group by 1, 2
),
buy as (
    select account_key, date_key,
           sum(filled_value) filter (where side = 'B') as buy_value,
           sum(filled_value) filter (where side = 'S') as sell_value
    from {{ ref('fact_order') }}
    where is_filled
    group by 1, 2
),
last_buy as (
    -- số thứ tự phiên của lần mua khớp gần nhất tính tới ngày (bao gồm ngày đó)
    select g.account_key, g.date_key,
           max(case when b.buy_value > 0 then g.trading_day_number end)
               over (partition by g.account_key order by g.date_day) as last_buy_td
    from grid g
    left join buy b on b.account_key = g.account_key and b.date_key = g.date_key
)
select
    c.account_key,
    c.account_id,
    c.date_key,
    c.date_day,
    c.trading_day_number,
    c.cash_balance::numeric(20,2)                                   as cash_balance,
    coalesce(mv.market_value, 0)::numeric(20,2)                      as market_value,
    (c.cash_balance + coalesce(mv.market_value, 0))::numeric(20,2)   as nav,
    coalesce(b.buy_value, 0)::numeric(20,2)                          as buy_value,
    coalesce(b.sell_value, 0)::numeric(20,2)                         as sell_value,
    -- số phiên kể từ lần mua khớp gần nhất; NULL nếu chưa mua lần nào trong dữ liệu
    c.trading_day_number - lb.last_buy_td                            as sessions_since_last_buy
from cash_cum c
left join mv  on mv.account_key = c.account_key and mv.date_key = c.date_key
left join buy b on b.account_key = c.account_key and b.date_key = c.date_key
left join last_buy lb on lb.account_key = c.account_key and lb.date_key = c.date_key
where c.is_trading_day

model.finova_dbt_lab.dim_branch.name: dim_branch
model.finova_dbt_lab.dim_branch.description: Grain: 1 dòng = 1 nút cây tổ chức + 1 dòng không xác định. region_code tính bằng đệ quy.
model.finova_dbt_lab.dim_branch.raw_code:
-- Grain: 1 dòng = 1 nút của cây tổ chức, cộng 1 dòng "không xác định"
-- Khu vực tính bằng đệ quy, không phụ thuộc độ sâu cây và không ghi cứng mã 'HO'
with recursive src as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_luyen_tap__branches') }}
),
tree as (
    select
        branch_code, branch_name, parent_code,
        0                              as branch_level,
        branch_code::text              as branch_path,
        array[branch_code]             as path_arr,
        null::text                     as region_code
    from src
    where parent_code is null
    union all
    select
        s.branch_code, s.branch_name, s.parent_code,
        t.branch_level + 1,
        t.branch_path || ' > ' || s.branch_code,
        t.path_arr || s.branch_code,
        case when t.branch_level = 0 then s.branch_code else t.region_code end
    from src s
    join tree t on s.parent_code = t.branch_code
    where not s.branch_code = any(t.path_arr)          -- chặn vòng khi dữ liệu bẩn
)
select
    {{ hash_key(['t.branch_code']) }}  as branch_key,
    t.branch_code,
    t.branch_name,
    t.parent_code,
    t.branch_level,
    case t.branch_level when 0 then 'Hội sở' when 1 then 'Khu vực'
                        when 2 then 'Chi nhánh' else 'Phòng giao dịch' end as level_name,
    t.branch_path,
    t.region_code,
    r.branch_name                      as region_name
from tree t
left join src r on r.branch_code = t.region_code
union all
select {{ unknown_key() }}, '<UNKNOWN>', 'Không xác định', null, null, 'Không xác định', null, null, null

model.finova_dbt_lab.dim_customer.name: dim_customer
model.finova_dbt_lab.dim_customer.description: Grain: 1 dòng = 1 phiên bản khách hàng (SCD2) + 1 dòng không xác định. Hiệu lực khi valid_from <= ngày < valid_to.
model.finova_dbt_lab.dim_customer.raw_code:
-- Grain: 1 dòng = 1 phiên bản khách hàng (SCD2), cộng 1 dòng "không xác định"
-- Phiên bản mới chỉ sinh khi nội dung (segment, kyc_status) khác phiên bản liền trước:
-- A → B → A là 3 phiên bản; dòng nạp lại không đổi nội dung không sinh phiên bản.
-- valid_to là mốc loại trừ: phiên bản hiệu lực khi valid_from <= ngày < valid_to.
with v as (
    select
        customer_id, segment, kyc_status, updated_at,
        {{ hash_key(['segment', 'kyc_status']) }} as hash_diff
    from {{ ref('stg_luyen_tap__customers') }}
),
chg as (
    select *, lag(hash_diff) over (partition by customer_id order by updated_at) as prev_hash
    from v
),
kept as (
    select customer_id, segment, kyc_status, updated_at as valid_from
    from chg
    where prev_hash is null or prev_hash <> hash_diff
),
ver as (
    select
        *,
        lead(valid_from) over (partition by customer_id order by valid_from)       as next_from,
        row_number()     over (partition by customer_id order by valid_from)       as version_no
    from kept
)
select
    {{ hash_key(['customer_id', 'valid_from']) }}  as customer_key,
    customer_id,
    segment,
    kyc_status,
    valid_from,
    coalesce(next_from, date '9999-12-31')         as valid_to,
    next_from is null                              as is_current,
    version_no
from ver
union all
select {{ unknown_key() }}, '<UNKNOWN>', 'UNKNOWN', 'UNKNOWN', date '1900-01-01', date '9999-12-31', false, 0

model.finova_dbt_lab.dim_date.name: dim_date
model.finova_dbt_lab.dim_date.description: Grain: 1 dòng = 1 ngày lịch. Ngày giao dịch loại thứ 7, chủ nhật và ngày trong seed exchange_holidays.
model.finova_dbt_lab.dim_date.raw_code:
-- Grain: 1 dòng = 1 ngày lịch trong khoảng var date_start..date_end
-- Ngày giao dịch = không phải thứ 7, chủ nhật, và không nằm trong seed exchange_holidays
with spine as (
    select d::date as date_day
    from generate_series('{{ var("date_start") }}'::date, '{{ var("date_end") }}'::date, interval '1 day') as d
),
flags as (
    select
        s.date_day,
        extract(isodow from s.date_day)::int          as iso_dow,
        extract(isodow from s.date_day) >= 6          as is_weekend,
        h.holiday_date is not null                    as is_holiday,
        h.holiday_name
    from spine s
    left join {{ ref('exchange_holidays') }} h on h.holiday_date = s.date_day
),
numbered as (
    select
        *,
        not is_weekend and not is_holiday             as is_trading_day,
        -- số thứ tự phiên tính tới ngày này (ngày nghỉ giữ số của phiên liền trước)
        sum(case when not is_weekend and not is_holiday then 1 else 0 end)
            over (order by date_day)                  as trading_day_number
    from flags
),
trading as (
    select trading_day_number, date_day as trading_date
    from numbered
    where is_trading_day
)
select
    {{ date_key('n.date_day') }}                      as date_key,
    n.date_day,
    n.iso_dow,
    case n.iso_dow when 1 then 'Thứ Hai' when 2 then 'Thứ Ba' when 3 then 'Thứ Tư'
                   when 4 then 'Thứ Năm' when 5 then 'Thứ Sáu' when 6 then 'Thứ Bảy'
                   else 'Chủ nhật' end                as day_name,
    n.is_weekend,
    n.is_holiday,
    n.holiday_name,
    n.is_trading_day,
    n.trading_day_number,
    -- phiên gần nhất trước ngày này và ngày thanh toán T+2 (chỉ có nghĩa với ngày giao dịch)
    prev_td.trading_date                              as prev_trading_date,
    case when n.is_trading_day then t2.trading_date end as settlement_date_t2,
    date_trunc('week', n.date_day)::date              as week_start,
    to_char(n.date_day, 'YYYY-MM')                    as month_key
from numbered n
left join trading prev_td on prev_td.trading_day_number = n.trading_day_number - case when n.is_trading_day then 1 else 0 end
left join trading t2      on t2.trading_day_number = n.trading_day_number + 2

model.finova_dbt_lab.fact_cash_txn.raw_code:
-- Grain: 1 dòng = 1 giao dịch tiền (fact giao dịch)
-- Chiều tiền lấy từ seed txn_type (cấu hình), không ghi cứng trong SQL
with t as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_luyen_tap__cash_txn') }}
),
a as (
    select * from {{ ref('dim_account') }} where account_id <> '<UNKNOWN>'
),
b as (
    select * from {{ ref('dim_branch') }} where branch_code <> '<UNKNOWN>'
)
select
    t.txn_id,
    {{ date_key('t.txn_date') }}                       as date_key,
    t.txn_ts,
    coalesce(a.account_key, {{ unknown_key() }})       as account_key,
    coalesce(b.branch_key,  {{ unknown_key() }})       as branch_key,
    a.customer_id,
    t.account_id                                       as source_account_id,   -- giữ để truy vết dòng mồ côi
    t.txn_type,
    tt.txn_group,
    tt.direction,
    t.amount,
    (tt.direction * t.amount)::numeric(20,2)           as signed_amount,
    t.ref_order_id
from t
left join {{ ref('txn_type') }} tt on tt.txn_type = t.txn_type
left join a on a.account_id = t.account_id
left join b on b.branch_code = a.branch_code

model.finova_dbt_lab.fact_order.name: fact_order
model.finova_dbt_lab.fact_order.description: Grain: 1 dòng = 1 lệnh, mọi trạng thái. Khớp = status FILLED.
model.finova_dbt_lab.fact_order.raw_code:
-- Grain: 1 dòng = 1 lệnh (fact giao dịch). Mọi lệnh, mọi trạng thái.
-- customer_key là phiên bản khách hiệu lực tại ngày đặt lệnh; không có phiên bản thì gắn "không xác định",
-- còn customer_id (khóa bền) vẫn giữ để phân tích theo khách.
-- Quy ước đo: chỉ trạng thái FILLED được tính là khớp (dữ liệu nguồn không có khối lượng khớp của PARTIAL).
with o as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_luyen_tap__orders') }}
),
a as (
    select * from {{ ref('dim_account') }} where account_id <> '<UNKNOWN>'
),
c as (
    select * from {{ ref('dim_customer') }} where customer_id <> '<UNKNOWN>'
),
i as (
    select * from {{ ref('dim_instrument') }} where symbol <> '<UNKNOWN>'
),
b as (
    select * from {{ ref('dim_branch') }} where branch_code <> '<UNKNOWN>'
)
select
    o.order_id,
    {{ date_key('o.trade_date') }}                                as date_key,
    o.order_ts,
    coalesce(a.account_key,    {{ unknown_key() }})               as account_key,
    coalesce(c.customer_key,   {{ unknown_key() }})               as customer_key,
    coalesce(b.branch_key,     {{ unknown_key() }})               as branch_key,
    coalesce(i.instrument_key, {{ unknown_key() }})               as instrument_key,
    a.customer_id,
    o.symbol,
    o.side,
    o.status,
    o.is_pre_session,
    o.status = 'FILLED'                                            as is_filled,
    o.quantity                                                     as order_qty,
    o.price                                                        as order_price,
    (o.quantity * o.price)::numeric(20,2)                          as order_value,
    case when o.status = 'FILLED' then o.quantity else 0 end       as filled_qty,
    case when o.status = 'FILLED' then (o.quantity * o.price)::numeric(20,2) else 0 end as filled_value,
    -- mua cộng, bán trừ
    case when o.status = 'FILLED'
         then (case o.side when 'B' then 1 else -1 end * o.quantity * o.price)::numeric(20,2)
         else 0 end                                                as net_filled_value
from o
left join a on a.account_id = o.account_id
left join c on c.customer_id = a.customer_id
           and o.trade_date >= c.valid_from
           and o.trade_date <  c.valid_to
left join i on i.symbol = o.symbol
left join b on b.branch_code = a.branch_code

model.finova_dbt_lab.fact_position_daily.name: fact_position_daily
model.finova_dbt_lab.fact_position_daily.description: Grain: 1 dòng = 1 tài khoản × 1 mã × 1 ngày chụp; chỉ có dòng khi total_qty > 0. Không cộng total_qty, market_value theo ngày.
model.finova_dbt_lab.fact_position_daily.raw_code:
-- Grain: 1 dòng = 1 tài khoản × 1 mã × 1 ngày chụp (fact chụp định kỳ, thưa: chỉ khi total_qty > 0)
-- total_qty, market_value là đại lượng cộng được theo tài khoản và mã, KHÔNG cộng theo ngày
with p as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_luyen_tap__position_daily') }}
),
a as (
    select * from {{ ref('dim_account') }} where account_id <> '<UNKNOWN>'
),
i as (
    select * from {{ ref('dim_instrument') }} where symbol <> '<UNKNOWN>'
),
b as (
    select * from {{ ref('dim_branch') }} where branch_code <> '<UNKNOWN>'
)
select
    {{ date_key('p.snapshot_date') }}                   as date_key,
    p.snapshot_date,
    coalesce(a.account_key,    {{ unknown_key() }})     as account_key,
    coalesce(i.instrument_key, {{ unknown_key() }})     as instrument_key,
    coalesce(b.branch_key,     {{ unknown_key() }})     as branch_key,
    p.account_id,
    a.customer_id,
    p.symbol,
    p.total_qty,
    p.receiving_qty,
    p.total_qty - p.receiving_qty                       as available_qty,
    p.close_price,
    (p.total_qty * p.close_price)::numeric(20,2)        as market_value
from p
left join a on a.account_id = p.account_id
left join i on i.symbol = p.symbol
left join b on b.branch_code = a.branch_code

-- Đối soát: thay đổi total_qty giữa hai ngày chụp liên tiếp = khối lượng khớp ròng trong ngày
-- Bảng chụp thưa: tài khoản × mã vắng mặt nghĩa là total_qty = 0
with days as (
    select distinct snapshot_date from {{ ref('fact_position_daily') }}
),
pairs as (
    select distinct account_id, symbol from {{ ref('fact_position_daily') }}
),
grid as (
    select p.account_id, p.symbol, d.snapshot_date,
           lag(d.snapshot_date) over (partition by p.account_id, p.symbol order by d.snapshot_date) as prev_date
    from pairs p cross join days d
),
qty as (
    select g.account_id, g.symbol, g.snapshot_date, g.prev_date,
           coalesce(cur.total_qty, 0)  as qty_cur,
           coalesce(prv.total_qty, 0)  as qty_prev
    from grid g
    left join {{ ref('fact_position_daily') }} cur
      on cur.account_id = g.account_id and cur.symbol = g.symbol and cur.snapshot_date = g.snapshot_date
    left join {{ ref('fact_position_daily') }} prv
      on prv.account_id = g.account_id and prv.symbol = g.symbol and prv.snapshot_date = g.prev_date
    where g.prev_date is not null
),
net as (
    select o.order_id, a.account_id, o.symbol, d.date_day, o.side, o.filled_qty
    from {{ ref('fact_order') }} o
    join {{ ref('dim_account') }} a on a.account_key = o.account_key
    join {{ ref('dim_date') }} d on d.date_key = o.date_key
    where o.is_filled
)
select q.account_id, q.symbol, q.snapshot_date, q.qty_prev, q.qty_cur,
       coalesce(sum(case n.side when 'B' then n.filled_qty else -n.filled_qty end), 0) as khop_rong
from qty q
left join net n
  on n.account_id = q.account_id and n.symbol = q.symbol
 and n.date_day > q.prev_date and n.date_day <= q.snapshot_date
group by q.account_id, q.symbol, q.snapshot_date, q.qty_prev, q.qty_cur
having q.qty_cur - q.qty_prev <> coalesce(sum(case n.side when 'B' then n.filled_qty else -n.filled_qty end), 0)

-- HV4 Singular Test: bridge_customer_account
-- Sô dòng bridge ngày D bằng số dòng link có ingested_ts <= cutoff_ts của D
-- cutoff_ts: Hiểu đơn giản là thời gian tiến hành capture data để tiến hành xuất báo cáo

    select
        as_of_date,
        cutoff_ts,
        count(*) as bridge_cnt
    from {{ ref('bridge_customer_account') }}
    group by
        as_of_date,
        cutoff_ts
),

link_per_day as (
    select
        b.as_of_date,
        b.cutoff_ts,
        b.bridge_cnt,
        count(l.link_customer_account_hk) as link_cnt
    from bridge_per_day b
    left join {{ ref('link_customer_account') }} l
        on l.ingested_ts <= b.cutoff_ts
    group by
        b.as_of_date,
        b.cutoff_ts,
        b.bridge_cnt
)

select
    as_of_date,
    cutoff_ts,
    bridge_cnt,
    link_cnt
from link_per_day
where bridge_cnt <> link_cnt

macro.dbt_postgres.postgres__list_relati.macro_sql:
{% macro postgres__list_relations_without_caching(schema_relation) %}
  {% call statement('list_relations_without_caching', fetch_result=True) -%}
    select
      '{{ schema_relation.database }}' as database,
      tablename as name,
      schemaname as schema,
      'table' as type
    from pg_tables
    where schemaname ilike '{{ schema_relation.schema }}'
    union all
    select
      '{{ schema_relation.database }}' as database,
      viewname as name,
      schemaname as schema,
      'view' as type
    from pg_views
    where schemaname ilike '{{ schema_relation.schema }}'
    union all
    select
      '{{ schema_relation.database }}' as database,
      matviewname as name,
      schemaname as schema,
      'materialized_view' as type
    from pg_matviews
    where schemaname ilike '{{ schema_relation.schema }}'
    union all
    select distinct
     '{{ schema_relation.database }}' as database,
     proname as name,
     ns.nspname as schema,
     'function' as type
    from pg_proc
     join pg_namespace as ns on pronamespace = ns.oid
    where ns.nspname ilike '{{ schema_relation.schema }}'
  {% endcall %}
  {{ return(load_result('list_relations_without_caching').table) }}
{% endmacro %}

macro.dbt_postgres.postgres__get_show_in.macro_sql:
{% macro postgres__get_show_indexes_sql(relation) %}
    select
        i.relname                                   as name,
        m.amname                                    as method,
        ix.indisunique                              as "unique",
        array_to_string(array_agg(a.attname), ',')  as column_names
    from pg_index ix
    join pg_class i
        on i.oid = ix.indexrelid
    join pg_am m
        on m.oid=i.relam
    join pg_class t
        on t.oid = ix.indrelid
    join pg_namespace n
        on n.oid = t.relnamespace
    join pg_attribute a
        on a.attrelid = t.oid
        and a.attnum = ANY(ix.indkey)
    where t.relname = '{{ relation.identifier }}'
      and n.nspname = '{{ relation.schema }}'
      and t.relkind in ('r', 'm')
    group by 1, 2, 3
    order by 1, 2, 3
{% endmacro %}

macro.dbt_postgres.postgres__get_relatio.name: postgres__get_relations
macro.dbt_postgres.postgres__get_relatio.macro_sql:
{% macro postgres__get_relations() -%}

  {#
      -- in pg_depend, objid is the dependent, refobjid is the referenced object
      --  > a pg_depend entry indicates that the referenced object cannot be
      --  > dropped without also dropping the dependent object.
  #}

  {%- call statement('relations', fetch_result=True) -%}
    select distinct
        dependent_namespace.nspname as dependent_schema,
        dependent_class.relname as dependent_name,
        referenced_namespace.nspname as referenced_schema,
        referenced_class.relname as referenced_name

    -- Query for views: views are entries in pg_class with an entry in pg_rewrite, but we avoid
    -- a seq scan on pg_rewrite by leveraging the fact there is an "internal" row in pg_depend for
    -- the view...
    from pg_class as dependent_class
    join pg_namespace as dependent_namespace on dependent_namespace.oid = dependent_class.relnamespace
    join pg_depend as dependent_depend on dependent_depend.refobjid = dependent_class.oid
        and dependent_depend.classid = 'pg_rewrite'::regclass
        and dependent_depend.refclassid = 'pg_class'::regclass
        and dependent_depend.deptype = 'i'

    -- ... and via pg_depend (that has a row per column, hence the need for "distinct" above, and
    -- making sure to exclude the internal row to avoid a view appearing to depend on itself)...
    join pg_depend as joining_depend on joining_depend.objid = dependent_depend.objid
        and joining_depend.classid = 'pg_rewrite'::regclass
        and joining_depend.refclassid = 'pg_class'::regclass
        and joining_depend.refobjid != dependent_depend.refobjid

    -- ... we can find the tables they query from in pg_class, but excluding system tables. Note we
    -- don't need need to exclude _dependent_ system tables, because they only query from other
    -- system tables, and so are automatically excluded by excluding _referenced_ system tables
    join pg_class as referenced_class on referenced_class.oid = joining_depend.refobjid
    join pg_namespace as referenced_namespace on referenced_namespace.oid = referenced_class.relnamespace
        and referenced_namespace.nspname != 'information_schema'
        and referenced_namespace.nspname not like 'pg\_%'

    order by
        dependent_schema, dependent_name, referenced_schema, referenced_name;

  {%- endcall -%}

  {{ return(load_result('relations').table) }}
{% endmacro %}

### Welcome!

Welcome to the auto-generated documentation for your dbt project!

### Navigation

You can use the `Project` and `Database` navigation tabs on the left side of the window to explore the models
in your project.

#### Project Tab
The `Project` tab mirrors the directory structure of your dbt project. In this tab, you can see all of the
models defined in your dbt project, as well as models imported from dbt packages.

#### Database Tab
The `Database` tab also exposes your models, but in a format that looks more like a database explorer. This view
shows relations (tables and views) grouped into database schemas. Note that ephemeral models are _not_ shown
in this interface, as they do not exist in the database.

### Graph Exploration
You can click the blue icon on the bottom-right corner of the page to view the lineage graph of your models.

On model pages, you'll see the immediate parents and children of the model you're exploring. By clicking the `Expand`
button at the top-right of this lineage pane, you'll be able to see all of the models that are used to build,
or are built from, the model you're exploring.

Once expanded, you'll be able to use the `--select` and `--exclude` model selection syntax to filter the
models in the graph. For more information on model selection, check out the [dbt docs](https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/model-selection-syntax).

Note that you can also right-click on models to interactively filter and explore the graph.
